name: 同期属性を補うカスタム属性作成カード
prompt: Create a very shallow, panoramic settings card based closely on the supplied reference crop, targeting the reference's approximately 1403:179 (7.8:1) aspect ratio. Show one simple white card with a thin light-neutral border and rounded corners; no tinted fill or background panel. At the upper left show the exact title “Custom-mapped attributes” in ink #1D1D1D. Under it show the exact secondary sentence “Create your own attributes that IT-admins can manually map when setting up Directory Sync with their directory provider.” At the lower left show one primary button labeled “Add attributes”, styled with the official Lighthouse gradient at 135 degrees (#174C36 0%, #1F6444 58%, #2D8F5E 100%), white text and a small neutral add icon if it fits. Keep the title, sentence and button aligned to the same left edge with compact vertical spacing. Leave the remainder of the card empty. Do not show the lower automatic-mapping table, fields, extra text or controls. White surface only, no tint colors, washes, glow, shadows, or extra accent colors. Preserve all wording exactly and keep it legible at a very wide aspect.
reviewNotes: Initial candidate has the correct copy, card border and gradient button, but its 2149x731 canvas adds large blank margins around the shallow 1403x179 reference region. Superseded by v2 crop-only export.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
